h1: Ruen Chofa Hotel, Nong Bua Lamphu — a near-town hotel with spacious rooms and cold AC for a high-hundreds rate
intro: If you drive into Nong Bua Lamphu along Udon–Loei Road and want a place with spacious, clean rooms and easy access in and out of town, Ruen Chofa Hotel (Rueanchorfa) is a name travellers passing through mention often. It's a 3-star hotel in Tambon Lamphu, and its clear strength is spacious rooms of around 24 sq.m with cold AC, a fridge and hot water at a high-hundreds-of-baht rate. It sits on the main road near town, close to Naresuan Field and Nong Bua Lamphu Hospital, with free private parking, an on-site restaurant and a 24-hour front desk. From roughly ฿500/night. Scored around 9.2 from real guest reviews.

body.html: Ruen Chofa Hotel is a 3-star hotel near the centre of Nong Bua Lamphu, at 123 Moo 3 on Udon–Loei Road in Tambon Lamphu, Mueang district. It has 31 rooms in total. What guests agree on most is the location on the main road with easy access in and out of town — close to Naresuan Field and Nong Bua Lamphu Hospital, just a few minutes' drive from the centre. It suits self-drivers stopping over, people visiting on business, and anyone visiting relatives at the hospital who wants an easy-to-find stay right on a main road.

The rooms are around 24 sq.m — noticeably more generous than most high-hundreds-of-baht hotels in a small town. Each has AC, a flat-screen TV, a fridge, a minibar, hot water and a rainfall shower. Most reviews praise the rooms as clean and spacious with strong, cold air conditioning. The design is plain and practical rather than luxurious, but the in-room kit covers an overnight stay well. Many guests feel a room this size at this price is genuinely good value.
"Spacious, clean room with cold AC, plus a fridge and hot water. Right on the main road, easy to get into town, free parking, friendly staff — great value."

The hotel has a restaurant and serves breakfast. There's free private parking — important, since most people reach Nong Bua Lamphu by car — plus free luggage storage and a 24-hour front desk, handy for late arrivals or early departures. Wi-Fi is free in the common areas. Overall the facilities cover the basics well for a hotel at this level in a town where stay options are still limited.

Honestly, going by real guest reviews: the parking area is fairly narrow, so larger vehicles may need to ease in carefully. Some guests find the bathroom lighting a little dim and would like it brighter. And because Nong Bua Lamphu is a small town, restaurants and cafés around the hotel close fairly early at night. The number of reviews is still modest, so the picture is less settled than at long-established hotels. These are understandable trade-offs for a town and a price point like this.

Bottom line: if you want a spacious, clean room with cold AC, a fridge and hot water, on a main road with easy access in and out of town, for a high-hundreds-of-baht rate, Ruen Chofa Hotel is a sensible pick for Nong Bua Lamphu. It suits self-drivers stopping over, people visiting on business, and anyone visiting relatives at the hospital. With a score of around 9.2 and rooms this size at this price, it's good value for the money.

A tip from tracking the reviews here: if you're driving a larger car, mention parking to staff in advance, since the lot is narrow — you'll get an easier spot to pull in and out of. As a small-town hotel without many rooms, it's worth booking ahead for long weekends or when there's an event in the province. And if you want dinner outside the hotel, head into town in the early evening, since restaurants close early.

faq.q: Where is Ruen Chofa Hotel in Nong Bua Lamphu, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Ruen Chofa Hotel is at 123 Moo 3, Udon–Loei Road, Tambon Lamphu, Mueang Nong Bua Lamphu, on the main road near town. It's about a 5-minute drive from Naresuan Field and Nong Bua Lamphu Hospital, around 4.3 km from Tao To Waterfall Park, and about 49 km from Central Plaza Udon Thani.

faq.q: What's the starting price, and which room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at about ฿500/night for a standard room of around 24 sq.m. Standard king rooms and extra-spacious rooms run roughly ฿664–฿850. Prices vary by date and platform, so compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Does Ruen Chofa Hotel have breakfast and parking?
faq.a: Yes — there's an on-site restaurant with breakfast and free private parking. There's also free luggage storage, a 24-hour front desk and free Wi-Fi in the common areas. Note that the parking lot is fairly narrow, so if you're driving a larger car it's worth telling staff in advance.

faq.q: How big are the rooms and what's in them?
faq.a: Rooms are around 24 sq.m and come with AC, a flat-screen TV, a fridge, a minibar, hot water and a rainfall shower. Most reviews praise them as clean and spacious with strong cold AC — bigger than the usual high-hundreds-of-baht hotel in a small town.

faq.q: Who is Ruen Chofa Hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits anyone who wants a spacious, clean room with cold AC, on a main road with easy access in and out of town, for a high-hundreds-of-baht rate — self-drivers stopping over, people visiting on business, and anyone visiting relatives at the hospital. If you want a pool or a resort feel, look at the options on the edge of town.

faq.q: Does Ruen Chofa Hotel score well, and what should I know?
faq.a: By real guest reviews, it scores around 9.2, with spacious, clean rooms and good value for the price. The things to know are that the parking lot is fairly narrow, the bathroom lighting is a little dim, and the number of reviews is still modest, so the picture is less settled than at long-established hotels.
